1.text: By the sky containing great stars

3.text: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

4.text: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench<sup foot_note="228212">1</sup>

footnotes.228212: - Or "May they be destroyed" or "cursed." The "companions of the trench" (or ditch) were agents of a tyrannical king who refused to allow his people to believe in Allāh. Their evil deed in obedience to their ruler earned for them the curse of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

6.text: When they were sitting near it.

7.text: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.<sup foot_note="228213">1</sup>

footnotes.228213: - After casting the believers into a trench filled with fire, they sat at its edge, watching them burn to death. This event occurred before the time of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) .

8.text: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

9.text: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.<sup foot_note="228214">1</sup>

10.text: Indeed, those who have tortured<sup foot_note="228215">1</sup> the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

footnotes.228215: - Or, in this instance, the literal meaning of "burned" is also appropriate.

11.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

12.text: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

13.text: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

14.text: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

17.text: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

19.text: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

20.text: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.<sup foot_note="228216">1</sup>

21.text: But this is an honored Qur’ān
